route.method: Direct complete JSON/source reads, exact unique block matching, native sealed-package ZIP inspection, Python zipfile archive generation, independent readback and byte/alias/source/XML/receipt validation.

scope.currentSource: Actual unchanged PR33 c9 source and test full-file bytes, exact uniquely located source excerpts, assertion bodies and helper bodies. Source equality is not a new runtime/compiler observation.
scope.historicalReceipts: All original runtime/compiler receipts, raw matrices, original claims, thresholds, limitations, private domain records and installed metadata are retained as historical observations; no compiler/runtime/HTTP/benchmark/model/denial/P-A-I replay.
scope.currentXml: Actual c306/r5 sealed package XML snapshots bound to current source pins. Snapshot bytes are not a new release or installed-metadata observation.
scope.liveReleaseRequirement: The enforced parent verifier must separately join current release DLL/PDB/XML and actual post-build seal/metadata. Historical installed tokens/MVID/receipt hashes cannot be rebound as current metadata.
scope.portableResolution: Archive lookup is exact catalog alias (separators normalized to /, case retained) plus declared SHA256 and byte length; no old Q filesystem fallback. Current src/ and tests/ pins resolve only to actual checkout source, never archived historical snapshots.
scope.historicalSourceSnapshots: Eight original final-format test snapshots and embedded historical proof excerpts remain only as explicitly historical inputs required by original pins. They cannot satisfy current source checks.

archiveProtocol.aliasNormalization: Replace backslash with / only; retain case; no path reinterpretation or filesystem fallback.
archiveProtocol.lookup: Exact alias lookup in input-catalog.json, require matching declared SHA256 and byte length, then read that unique archive entry and recompute SHA256.
archiveProtocol.currentSourceLookup: Actual checkout src/ and tests/ files only. Zero archive aliases begin src/ or tests/. Historical test snapshots retain their artifacts/audit-resolution/final-format/originals/ prefixes and cannot satisfy current pins.
archiveProtocol.deduplication: Only identical SHA256 and byte-length bindings share an entry; independent reopening verified every entry and every original external/probe alias.
archiveProtocol.rawInputPreservation: Raw actual matrix.json is unchanged, including absolute original Source strings. Every raw receipt and domain record is byte-preserved; no normalization or regeneration.
archiveProtocol.originalRoots: Read-only preparation inputs; original private-history directory and all original artifact roots remain untouched.

credentialScan.scope: All 2340 decompressed selected ZIP entries, all direct members of the two archived nupkgs, current proof index and catalog; UTF-8 and UTF-16LE views where NUL bytes exist. No historical-root or full-repository scan.
limitations: Bounded pattern scan, not an assurance that every possible credential format is absent.
Compressed nupkg direct members were expanded; no recursive binary container decoding, arbitrary obfuscation, encrypted payload decoding or entropy-based inference.
No scan of unselected private-history files, original artifact roots, Git history, remote assets, external publication or unrelated user-owned inputs.
No external credential validation; finding values are never emitted.

actions: Integrate the enforced current verifier in eng/harness/StableApiContracts.fs and required CI.
Resolve archived historical inputs strictly by declared alias and SHA, with no old-Q fallback; check actual checkout source pins independently.
Join actual post-build live current release DLL/PDB/XML and metadata against the real seal. Do not reuse historical installed tokens, DLL/MVID or runtime/compiler observations as current execution.
Run the parent-required full gates; this child performed no compiler/runtime/HTTP/benchmark/model/denial/P-A-I replay.

limitations: Credential evidence is a bounded selected-input pattern scan, not a whole-repository or entire private-history scan.
Historical matrix platform/compiler/framework provenance is retained raw; historical platform binaries are not represented as a newly executed portable compiler environment.
The two current XML snapshots are virtual catalog aliases inside the ZIP, not checkout source files or a claim that current metadata was rebuilt.
Original historical test-source snapshots and proof-index embedded bodies remain archival evidence only; no archived source alias can satisfy a live source check.
Preparation proves bytes, identities and exact migrations; final current semantic/release acceptance remains parent-owned.
